title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a $\tau$-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experimen

translated_title: 作为开放量子系统的扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过逆转令牌序列上的经典扩散过程来生成文本。我们证明，它们的连续时间前向与反向动力学可以嵌入到开放量子系统的框架中，该框架描述的是与其环境相互作用的量子系统。这一联系为将扩散采样扩展至句子状态的叠加态、以及修改底层的生成动力学提供了基础。我们构建了一种 τ-跳跃 unraveling 模拟方案，可以在每一步同时更新多个令牌位置的情况下模拟这些状态的随机轨迹。这使得基于叠加提示或叠加思想进行条件生成成为可能，我们分别称之为提示叠加和思想叠加。同一形式化体系还产生了量子启发重掩码：通过对掩码扩散动力学进行扰动，得到一种基于置信度的规则，用于修订先前已生成的令牌。实验……
tldr: 该论文将扩散语言模型的连续时间前向与反向动力学嵌入开放量子系统框架，提出了提示叠加（SoP）、思想叠加（SoT）和量子启发重掩码（QIR），实现了基于句子状态叠加的条件文本生成以及基于置信度的已生成令牌修订。
en_tdlr: This paper embeds the continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics of diffusion language models into the framework of open quantum systems, introducing Superposition of Prompts (SoP), Superposition of Thoughts (SoT), and Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR) to enable text generation conditioned on superpositions of sentence states and confidence-based revision of previously generated tokens.
